# opal_script (Data Source)

Script DataSource

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "opal_script" "my_script" {
  id = "32acc112-21ff-4669-91c2-21e27683eaa1"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) The ID of the OpalScript.

### Read-Only

- `name` (String) The name of the OpalScript.
- `script` (String) The source of the OpalScript's latest version.
- `script_type` (String) The kind of automation an OpalScript performs.
- `updated_at` (String) The date the OpalScript was last updated.
- `version` (Number) The version number of the OpalScript's latest version.
